question: Does RING-READ's incremental reader R3 read every stage of the 26,441 TOUCH-CENSUS arrangements and FRESH-COUNT's 247 mixed stages from their bond-distance tables alone, what do its failures share, and is its least horizon the largest junction less one?

definitions.stages: rounds 0-8 under the census's cheapest counts, at most 120 junctions; FRESH-COUNT reader_mixed replayed
definitions.table: exact to largest + 2 over bonds with a side of at most min(junctions, 6) junctions (complete at 14 or fewer)
definitions.readers: R1, R3 (reader3.r3, hash-checked), R3m (no two-shared filter), FRESH-COUNT bonds.read_stars on mixed stages
definitions.verdicts: exact, outside_swap, same_states (same parity span), misread

public_inputs.run: scripts/longrun.py launch job.py --out runs/census-read (12 workers, 900 s, 1G per case, MemoryMax 14G); .venv/bin/python -B gate.py; .venv/bin/python -B readout.py runs/census-read
public_inputs.reused: RING-READ-20261118-001B reader3.py and A ringread.py, TOUCH-CENSUS-20261118-001B arrlib.py, FRESH-COUNT-20261118-001B freelib.py and bonds.py (closed records)

forbidden_inputs: Rounds, parents, history or names given to a reader
Changing C0-C6 after any case is read
cheapest_meaningful_control: the ring rounds 10 and 15 (RING-READ) and FRESH-COUNT's own reader on the mixed stages

predictions.C1: rigid stages exact or outside swap
predictions.C1b: no pair sharing two: same allowed states
predictions.C2: R3m same allowed states everywhere; R3 misreads in most arrangements sharing two
predictions.C3: no non-swap same-state output at 3-connected stages
predictions.C6: R1 misreads in >= 10% of arrangements past round 3

stop_rule: One run, readout, classification of misreads; no new reader in this study.

amendments.change: Amendment 1: exact-table sensitivity (C7) and timed-out shards rerun one per case
Amendment 2: names; R3n and a second pass with renamings (N1-N5)
Amendment 3: gate C0(b') failed; every stage read again on the exact table (pass 3)
Amendment 4: pass 3 stopped after 77 shards; remaining arrangements with large stages sampled

Amendment 5 (after a preliminary readout, post-hoc): closed-stage bonds and R3n's dependent rule fixed; table-symmetry test; the whole census read again (pass 5); large stages for one arrangement in ten
